summary: Highway Holdings filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 17, 2026 press release announcing receipt on September 15, 2026 of Nasdaq's second 180-day extension to regain minimum bid price compliance. The Nasdaq Capital Market listed issuer now has until March 15, 2027 to achieve a closing bid of at least US$1.00 per share for ten consecutive business days. Shares continue trading uninterrupted under HIHO; a reverse stock split is possible if needed. This is a routine listing-compliance notice, not a special situation.
